comments.note: Version bumped to 1.0.0 (not 0.3.0). Rationale: this is the first stable public release per the plan's explicit 'Tag version — v1.0.0 release' instruction. The ledger plugin sub-path export (@mistralys/persona-builder/plugins/ledger) completes the full public API surface described in the plan. No existing API was removed or changed, so there is no breaking change — 1.0.0 is a marketing/stability statement, not a semver breaking-change indicator.

Package manifest is clean for npm publish: 'files': ['dist'] in package.json means only dist/ ships. dist/plugins/ledger/ contains index.js, index.cjs, index.d.ts, index.d.cts, and source maps. No .test. files, no src/ TypeScript sources, no fixtures in the tarball. No .npmignore required.

Node.js was not available in the sandbox shell (npm pack --dry-run could not be executed). Package manifest correctness was verified through direct file inspection: 'files' field, dist/ directory listing, and absence of test/source files in dist/. This should be re-verified manually before actual npm publish.
